decisions.reason: The badge presentation changes do not alter the amount or automatic distribution of coded-referral commissions.
The proposed Trailblazer Referral badge does not change referral-ticket recipients or ticket quantities.
Badge icon and badge-set changes do not affect email authentication or dashboard access.
The badge changes do not alter ticket allocation for mints without referral codes.
The badge presentation decision does not change Big Block winners, prize amounts, pool target, or draw condition.
The badge presentation decision does not change Small Block eligibility, prizes, pool funding, or draw trigger.
The badge changes do not affect the fiat on-ramp provider, conversion asset, or buyer access method.
The requirement that permanent badges remain visible in metadata is still valid unchanged; the source only changes badge selection and visual presentation.
The badge presentation changes do not alter the manual prize-claim flow.
The badge changes do not modify ticket eligibility, reset behavior, burning, or carry-forward rules.
The badge presentation decision does not affect royalty enforcement, prize-pool funding, or ticket creation.
The badge changes do not affect public API authentication or the information exposed through those APIs.
